thread:
jules_cs: FYI - Greenline (Enterprise, CSM=Harper) just finished onboarding pilot. They surfaced three product blockers that are preventing org-wide rollout: 1) route-level rate caps to avoid cost spikes when a noisy team runs large batches; 2) a set of fast-start embedding prompt templates for 128-token contexts (their use-case is search & similarity); 3) clearer per-route quota countdown + export for finance. They called out renewal as 'at risk' if not addressed in next 30 days.

mina_pm: Can you paste the concrete asks and any recordings/screens? Need to know severity + whether they have a workaround.

jules_cs: Screenshots + meeting notes here: https://notes.example.com/greenline-onboard. Workaround: they manually throttle from client side but it's error-prone.

lee_support: I pulled the support threads, attaching one with customer logs: https://support.example.com/GL-5521. There's also a short screen capture of the Console where quota card is confusing.

omar_research: Quick triage score from ticket text: route-rate-cap = high revenue impact (potential $70k/mo exposure), freq=4 mentions; templates = medium revenue, high UX lift; quota-export = low dev, medium impact for finance teams. My calc: priority = revenue*freq/dev_days.

paul_pdm: Please add 1-line descriptions so I can draft PRD outlines. Also flag any legal/compliance constraints (e.g., cross-account billing).

jules_cs: route-level caps: "Allow admins to set token or spend caps per API route with soft/hard enforcement and alerting"
templates: "Ship 6 short-context embedding prompt templates + example dataset and evals for similarity tuning"
quota-export: "CSV export of route-level monthly token usage, plus dashboard countdown and export webhook"

mina_pm: Paul/omar - rough T-shirt sizes by EOD? Lee - attach the video + key log lines to one ticket. I'll spin up tickets and tag product.

notif-bot: Created ticket RED-ENG-712 (route-caps), RED-ENG-713 (embedding-templates), RED-ENG-714 (quota-export). Linked support GL-5521.

lee_support: Added logs + 38s video clip to RED-ENG-712 and RED-ENG-714.

paul_pdm: T-shirt sizes: route caps = L (2.5w), templates = M (6d), quota export = S (2d). No immediate compliance flags.

omar_research: I'll run a quick grep across last 6 months for similar phrases and drop a CSV:
```
customer,issue,count,last_seen
Greenline,route-rate-cap,4,2026-03-18
Greenline,templates-128,2,2026-03-16
```

jules_cs: Thanks all. Next steps: Mina to decide roadmap placement; Paul to draft PRDs for RED-ENG-712/713/714; Omar to add frequency metrics; Lee to attach artifacts. If Greenline escalates, CSM will request a 1:1 next Wed. :thumbsup:
